library_preparation_preflight.summary: spring-batch-core 6.0.4 pulls in spring-jdbc, spring-tx, spring-context and micrometer transitively. Its JDBC-backed JobRepository (the schema SQL scripts, the DAOs) needs an embedded database, which is not on the classpath by default.

deterministic_setup.reason: Spring Batch's JDBC JobRepository, job explorer and job operator need a DataSource. The core artifact ships schema-hsqldb.sql, and embedded HSQLDB is the lightest in-process option. Version 2.7.3 matches the version already tested in this repo (tests/src/org.hsqldb/hsqldb/2.7.3).

library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: No Docker image, environment variable or system property is needed. Build the DataSource with EmbeddedDatabaseBuilder (spring-jdbc, already transitive) using EmbeddedDatabaseType.HSQL. Load the schema from classpath:/org/springframework/batch/core/schema-hsqldb.sql (check the exact path inside the 6.0.4 jar). Then create the JobRepository through JdbcJobRepositoryFactoryBean or @EnableBatchProcessing with a DataSourceTransactionManager. Also exercise ResourcelessJobRepository, which needs no database. Cover Job and Step builders (JobBuilder, StepBuilder with tasklet and chunk-oriented steps), a JobOperator or JobLauncher run, listeners, ExecutionContext serialization (the Jackson-based serializer needs jackson-databind, which is an optional dependency, so add it only if it is not already available), and the SpEL-based late binding of step-scope and job-scope parameters. Do not add the optional integrations (MongoDB, AspectJ) unless a test needs them.
risks: Spring Batch 6 changed its default configuration, so the schema script path and the @EnableBatchProcessing defaults (resourceless versus JDBC) should be checked against the 6.0.4 jar.

The JDBC job repository and the Jackson ExecutionContext serializer use reflection, resource loading and proxies. Native Image may need extra metadata, and that is what the generated tests should surface.
HSQLDB itself needs reflection and resource metadata. The repo already has an hsqldb entry, so check whether it covers what is needed. I did not check that.
I did not run any Gradle or Native Image verification. The recommendation comes from the 6.0.4 POM and the repo's existing tests.
